messages.content: Write a mail to campus supervisor that I will be arriving at 10 pm on 2nd of julyprior arrangement of the new room alloted to me 2nd year

Here's a concise and polite email you can send:

---

**Subject:** Arrival and Room Arrangement on 2nd July

Dear [Supervisor's Name],

I hope this mail finds you well.

I am writing to inform you that I will be arriving on **2nd July at around 10 PM** for the start of my **2nd year**. I kindly request you to ensure the **prior arrangement of the newly allotted room** so that I can settle in without any inconvenience.

Please let me know if any further information or documentation is needed from my side.

Thank you for your support.

Warm regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Roll Number]  
[Your Department]  

---

Let me know if you want to add your room number or any other detail.
Instead of I kindly part like wrote is since admin office won't be open

Got it. Here's a revised version with a more direct and reason-based tone:

---

**Subject:** Arrival and Room Arrangement on 2nd July

Dear [Supervisor's Name],

I hope you're doing well.

I’m writing to inform you that I will be arriving on **2nd July at around 10 PM** for the start of my **2nd year**. Since the **admin office will be closed by then**, I request that the **arrangements for the newly allotted room** be made in advance so that I can move in without any issues.

Please let me know if any action is needed from my side beforehand.

Regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Roll Number]  
[Your Department]

---

Let me know if you'd like to personalize it further.
